title: [maintainer] refactor(app-shell): split StudioDesignSurface.tsx (12,882 lines) along its component seams, one move-only slice per PR
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgBDcBNVmSmo7VFHpj

Filing gate: ruling 6583399215 on #29465 (letter A, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-02T17:11Z), whose after-ruling stroke names a hand-slice card for this file under #24586's ruling, because a React component's closures are not mechanically separable. The file crossed 10,000 lines after #24586 was ruled and never got its card. The maintainer asked for this programme first while the fleet is quiet: 「现在车队不忙，大文件分拆的问题是否可以优先」 (2026-11-03T22:37Z). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it and routes it.

Ruling-ref: 6583399215
Governs: #24586 ruling A (6270097840: one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines, move-only slices, serial with in-flight PRs); the declaration-file bar of ruling 6348891160; ruling 6597555122 item 3 (a test or gate that reads the file by path gains the new module in its reading list in the same PR).

**Reader who acts:** a `domain:ui` seat, one slice per dispatch.

## What to do

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 12,882 lines on `main` `c92b8872` and one of the busiest files in `ui/` (#29465 measured 60 commits in 7 days on 2026-11-02).
- Each slice moves one seam (a sub-component, a hook, or a group of pure helpers) into its own module beside the file, move-only: no logic, prop or behaviour change; the moved text is byte-identical apart from imports and `export`.
- Each slice is serial with the file's in-flight PRs: read the open PRs touching the file before claiming, and take a seam none of them edits.
- The first slice proposes a seam table (seam, lines, inbound reads, risk), the way #25467 cut 1 did; later slices take the next row.

## Done when

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is below 10,000 lines, or a slice report shows the remaining seams cannot move without a logic change (then a decision goes to #29465).

Re-measure: `git show origin/main:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx | wc -l`.

Dedupe (open and closed): `StudioDesignSurface`, `split in:title`, `拆分`, `29465`. Hits: #29465 (names this card as owed), #24586; the `StudioDesignSurface` hits are feature fixes, none a split card. **New.**
